name: Retire CoreLink v2 before the Oct 31 sunset
label: Retire CoreLink v2 before the Oct 31 sunset
brief: Retire the CoreLink v2 API before the Oct 31 sunset: move the last integrations to the CoreLink API v3, rotate the API keys, update the nightly reconciliation, and re-test ACH settlement files.

name: Launch new mobile banking app
label: Launch a new mobile banking app
brief: Launch a new mobile banking app on top of the member portal and online banking: SSL certificates and DNS for the new domain, Okta identity and access, and debit card controls.

name: FINTRAC reporting overhaul
label: Overhaul FINTRAC reporting
brief: Overhaul FINTRAC reporting and AML monitoring, including large cash transaction reports fed from ACH payments and the nightly reconciliation.
